## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T14:54Z

Read fresh. `/automation` relays `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal`'s remedy ("on the REST door add ?package=") on four routes, but reads no `?package=`, so following the remedy loops on the same `409`. The working save is `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME?package=P`.
- **`priority:p2`:** the refusal is right, but the remedy at that door cannot be followed.
- **Lane `domain:cli`** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`, where the relay sits): the door states a remedy it can honour. The fixing seat picks one:
  - name the `/meta/flow` door in the relayed text;
  - or have `/automation` read `?package=`. That is a REST widening (`Clause-②: yes`), so it goes spec-lane with the contract-tier review.

  The minting sentence in `metadata-protocol` stays door-agnostic.
- `finding` leaves on grading.

Stop on a breach and explain it in the report. ⛔ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` (`packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal`, the minting sentence) is read, not edited: triage keeps it door-agnostic (`6171263447`), and #23429's in-flight claim names `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**`.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call")
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the runtime automation door's verbatim relay of a remedy written for another door, platform code in this lane | the `/meta` door: `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME?package=P` saves the row, and `/automation` reads no `?package=` | any `/automation` caller on a flow name two packages hold; measured once by #23292's dev (`6170366180`). PR #23499 measured that no automation caller holds a package to name.
Thread-read: 6171263447
Serial constraints cleared: `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`: none of the 8 open PRs edits it, and none of the 16 `pm:dispatched` claims names it. Its last landing is PR #23499 (#23292, `111b5821c`), which pins this `409` at the three save call sites; those pins move with this card. The minting file is held by #23429 (PR #23469 and PR #23461, another lane) and is out of this surface. `data.ts` (this seat's #23491 fold) is a different file in the same package; the seat's ruling exempts the same package.
